title: Pure Mystical Elf
summary: Yugi Muto's iconic Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Normal Monster Mystical Elf (800 ATK / 2000 DEF) gained a full modern control engine with Mystical Elf - White Lightning! While you have a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster in your GY (such as Dark Magician or Blue-Eyes White Dragon, dumped via Magicians' Souls), Mystical Elf - White Lightning activates as a Quick Effect during your opponent's turn to negate the activated effect of an opponent's monster on the field AND revive a Normal Monster from your GY—and if you control 'Mystical Elf', it also forces ALL monsters your opponent controls to attack her while you prepare a Shield & Sword counterattack!

allow.Magicians' Souls: Level 1 Spellcaster that sends Level 7 Normal Monster Dark Magician from your Deck to the GY for cost—immediately fulfilling Mystical Elf - White Lightning's condition and letting White Lightning revive that Dark Magician from the GY during the opponent's turn!
allow.Illusion of Chaos: Searches Magicians' Souls from your Deck.
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons the original Level 4 Normal Monster Mystical Elf directly from your Deck while you control no monsters—putting 'Mystical Elf' on the field so Mystical Elf - White Lightning's bonus effect is active!
allow.Rescue Rabbit: Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of the original Mystical Elf directly from your Deck.
allow.Piercing the Darkness: Draws 1 card every turn when you Normal/Special Summon Mystical Elf or revive Dark Magician/Blue-Eyes via Mystical Elf - White Lightning, and gives your Normal Monsters ATK equal to the opponent's battling monster's ATK!
allow.Secret Village of the Spellcasters: Field Spell that locks your opponent out of activating Spell Cards while you control Mystical Elf or Mystical Elf - White Lightning.
allow.Shield & Sword: Swaps the original ATK and DEF of all monsters on the field, turning your 2000 DEF Mystical Elf and Mystical Elf - White Lightning into 2000 ATK attackers.
allow.Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians: Link-3 Spellcaster that revives Mystical Elf - White Lightning or Dark Magician from your GY.
allow.Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden: Link-1 LIGHT Spellcaster summoned using a Level 4 Mystical Elf.

main: Mystical Elf - White Lightning

Signature Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster retrain (800 ATK / 2000 DEF): when an opponent's monster activates its effect while you have a Level 5+ Normal Monster in your GY (Quick Effect), Special Summons itself from your hand, negates that effect, AND revives a Normal Monster from your GY if you control 'Mystical Elf'; during your opponent's Battle Phase (Quick Effect), revives a Normal Monster from your GY and forces all opponent's monsters to attack it!
Mystical Elf

Yugi's classic Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Normal Monster (800 ATK / 2000 DEF): summoned from the Deck by Unexpected Dai and Rescue Rabbit; controlling her unlocks the bonus Normal Monster revival on Mystical Elf - White Lightning's Quick Effect!
Dark Magician

Level 7 DARK Spellcaster Normal Monster (2500 ATK): sent from Deck to GY by Magicians' Souls to immediately turn on Mystical Elf - White Lightning in your hand, then revived to your field by White Lightning's Quick Effect!
Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Normal Monster (3000 ATK): Level 5+ Normal Monster that can be revived from the GY by Mystical Elf - White Lightning during the opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase.
Magicians' Souls
Sends Dark Magician from your Deck to the GY for cost—making Mystical Elf - White Lightning live in your hand before you even Normal Summon—and Special Summons itself or Dark Magician!
Illusion of Chaos
Searches Magicians' Souls from your Deck.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons the original Mystical Elf directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of the original Mystical Elf from your Deck.
Piercing the Darkness

Draws 1 card once per turn when you summon Mystical Elf or when Mystical Elf - White Lightning revives Dark Magician/Blue-Eyes White Dragon, and boosts their ATK by the opponent's monster's ATK during battle!
Secret Village of the Spellcasters
Locks your opponent out of activating Spell Cards while you control Mystical Elf, Mystical Elf - White Lightning, or Dark Magician.
Shield & Sword
Turns your 2000 DEF Mystical Elf and Mystical Elf - White Lightning into 2000 ATK beatsticks.
extra: Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians
Link-3 Spellcaster that gains Spell Counters and revives Mystical Elf - White Lightning or Dark Magician from your GY during either player's Main Phase.
Link-1 LIGHT Spellcaster made with a Level 4 Mystical Elf.
